lines: #You don't have time? You found time to *scroll.*
Your mind is very good at protecting you from *discomfort.*
And very bad at protecting you from *regret.*
Monday? Monday has been coming for *years.*
Every one of them is a door you closed on *yourself.*
So today, catch yourself in the *middle* of one.
One year from now, the excuse will still be *there.*
The only question is whether *you* will be.
Same place. Same story. Or somewhere *new.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: What's the Excuse You Keep Repeating?
post.caption: Excuses are always believable. That's what makes them dangerous. ⚡
post.first_comment: Drop the excuse you're done with today 👇
